title: KUSTOM ENTERTAINMENT, INC. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: Kustom Entertainment, Inc. issued a Form 8-K on April 17, 2026, announcing it entered into a revised non-binding Memorandum of Understanding with Cycurion, Inc. regarding the contemplated divestiture of the Company's Video Solutions Segment. This MOU replaces a previous non-binding MOU announced on January 22, 2026.
key_points: Kustom Entertainment (ticker: KUST, listed on Nasdaq Capital Market) announced revised MOU with Cycurion, Inc.
The MOU concerns divestiture of the Company's Video Solutions Segment
This revised MOU replaces the original MOU dated January 22, 2026
The MOU is non-binding, indicating the transaction is not yet finalized
Stanton E. Ross serves as Chairman, President and CEO of Kustom Entertainment
